answer: Because the juniper derivation is checked against the shale nonce, the onyx audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 23 aliases produces 23 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 13 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
